body:
Registration's board and four visit pages use the shared Clean Look surfaces, visible board heading and responsive field targets. Edit stays secondary when Send to Waiting is available. This is the four-page presentation foundation; full demo workspace/content composition remains in separate dependent drafts.

Final head 7457a39d90ad0c780bbae2ada79fb044f73bcbc4 contains main d0f37b5c1864b796fc7b4224996bd917551af3e7. All nine scoped blobs remain identical to the previously reviewed ecadc1125 candidate, and all four page scripts remain byte-identical to main. No workflow, payload, branch guard, permission or clinical behavior changes.

The original owner-approved appearance expectations and delegated REG6 target expectation remain unchanged. The four local controls have a 44px phone/tablet minimum: quick identification type, Consultation/OTC buttons and Edit member/staff reference. Existing assertion adaptations retain their behavioral and layout checks. Emergency Contact, Family and TRI2 remain separate.

Validation at the unchanged original source: 2,205 frontend tests, types/build, changed-page lint/format and independent source review. Historical actual-browser evidence at ecadc1125 covers 24 control measurements and 12 captures at 390/768/1440, light/dark, with focus and unobstructed targets. This is bounded control geometry, not whole-page demo parity.

After upstream integration, 106 focused frontend tests, types and production build passed at d8c77e296. The final merge adds only the unrelated Trial fixture; all nine blobs remain unchanged and final independent exact-head parity is clear. No new browser execution or full backend local test is claimed. Fresh CI at the final head is required before merge. Synthetic data only; no deployment.
